title: Database of the Han Wooden Slips Character Dictionary (WCD)

description.en: The LOD dataset of ASCDC_Database of the Han Wooden Slips Character Dictionary (WCD) was created by the Academia Sinica Center for Digital Cultures (ASCDC) and based on the metadata from the “Han Wooden Slips Character Dictionary” (簡牘字典―史語所藏居延漢簡資料庫, https://wcd-ihp.ascdc.sinica.edu.tw/woodslip/), which was established and maintained by the Institute of History and Philology, Academia Sinica, Taipei, Taiwan (ROC). The data includes information on the archaeological objects of Han Wooden Slips, which were created in the Han dynasty (206 B.C.-220 A.D.) and excavated in the early 1930s during the Sino-Swedish Scientific Expedition. The data can serve as a profound source for the digital study of ancient Chinese history. Containing 207 data records and 143,264 triples, the textual content within the LOD dataset is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution (CC 0), while the digitized images are under CC-BY-NC-ND 3.0.
